name: fund_mode_preservation
finding: The registered builder sets fund_mode explicitly. General build_dataset and the legacy label-only repair do not carry it, and load_snapshot/compare_history do not reject omission. Current three registered bundles have the correct mode; their numerical experiments are unaffected.
change: After all current runs and audits terminate, preserve the uniform fund-history control in generic rebuilds and legacy label-only repairs; require loaded/history-compared bundles to agree with that control. No execution, model, feature, target, risk, cost or alpha-selection formula changes.
validation: Archive the three pre-fix modules and four failing mode regressions before editing.
Keep all current trained source identities as actually executed; do not rewrite old fit or validation receipts.

Prove AST differences are limited to the mode validation/preservation paths in dataset.py, preprocessing.py and snapshots.py. All execution, feature arithmetic, model fitting, allocation, risk and account modules remain byte-identical.

Rebuild the parent and all three ETF datasets from their frozen raw inputs, requiring exact original metadata, actions, status, calendar, labels, model table, panels, scores and the intended fund mode. Do not replace any frozen bundle.
Reload all 144 new models through the ordinary guarded verifier; retain earlier 48 parent reloads and exact 1425 parent/4275 new accounts as evidence under unchanged executed numerical paths.
Run the full local checks and freeze a new plan only after mode closure. Preserve complete-economic-exposure uncertainty and all other registration gates.
adoption: Metadata preservation only; no return-selected changes, new alpha candidates, redefinition of success or assumed forward performance.
